facts.business: Allcargo Logistics Limited is an Indian end-to-end logistics solutions provider integrating transportation, warehousing, and smart supply chain management, with key verticals in Express Distribution, Air Freight, E-commerce Logistics, and First and Last Mile Delivery.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The group has set out to achieve 100% carbon neutrality by 2040.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matters: a) Composite scheme of arrangement involving demerger of International Supply Chain business approved by NCLT on October 10, 2025 and accounting treatment overriding Ind AS requirements. b) Search operations carried out by Income Tax Authorities during previous year ended March 31, 2025 at various premises of the Company, its erstwhile subsidiary and group company business premises and at the residences of three key managerial personnel, the consequent notice received and management's position thereof.
